coverage: Unofficial ~220-page compilation (credited 'LeetCode, Internet') of about 150 LeetCode problems in 11 chapters (Linked List, Trees, Graphs, Heaps, Arrays, Strings, Bit Manipulation, Maths, Matrix, Design). Each entry is the LeetCode statement, its URL and one accepted Python 2-style solution; no explanations, diagrams or complexity analysis. Several TOC entries have no body pages. Local PDF only; licensing unclear.

refs.title: Linked List chapter
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: 12 classic list problems (cycle, reverse, merge, palindrome, dedupe, nth-from-end); statement plus Python solution each, no commentary.

refs.title: Trees chapter
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: ~38 binary tree and BST problems (traversals, LCA, path sums, construct, serialize); the broadest chapter, still code-only.

refs.title: Graphs chapter
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: 5 graph problems (components, course schedule I/II, valid tree, islands); solutions build a verbose adjacency-list Graph class each time.

refs.title: Heaps chapter
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Only 2 problems (merge k lists, kth largest); thin coverage of heap patterns.

refs.title: Arrays chapter
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: ~32 array problems mixing hashing, two pointers (2Sum/3Sum family, container, trapping water) and prefix tricks; code-only.

refs.title: Strings chapter
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: 6 easy string problems (anagram, palindrome, parentheses, isomorphic); short Python solutions.

refs.title: Bit Manipulation chapter
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Only Sum of Two Integers and Single Number are actually present; the II/III entries in the TOC have no pages.

refs.title: Maths chapter
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Number problems (reverse integer, pow, power of three, nim) plus Subsets I/II misfiled here; many TOC entries are missing from the body.

refs.title: Matrix chapter
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: 6 grid problems: rotate image, set zeroes, search a 2D matrix I/II, spiral matrix I/II.

refs.title: Design chapter
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Single problem: LRU Cache.
